title: inventory.reservation.confirmed — Payload Schema
description: Emitted by erp.inventory when a reservation is converted into a dispatched fulfillment following confirmed payment. After this event, the reserved units are no longer part of quantity_reserved — they are decremented from quantity_on_hand and the reservation is closed. erp.inventory also emits a corresponding inventory.stock.updated reflecting the updated aggregate_available.

reservation_id.description: Identifier of the reservation being confirmed. Matches the reservation_id from the corresponding inventory.reservation.created message.

order_id.description: Identifier of the Commerce order associated with this reservation.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core.

location_id.description: Location from which the units were dispatched.

quantity.description: Number of units confirmed and dispatched.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the reservation was confirmed in ERP Core.
